thread:
Maya K: heads-up, seeing a sharp p95 jump for a single tenant over the last 8m, from ~180ms -> 1.2s. node g-12 is the hotspot. link to chart: https://grafana.redwood/rt/txn/176543
Jon P: which tenant? any recent deploys? :eyes:
Maya K: tenant=acme-internal-prod, no deploys. pattern seems correlated to a handful of requests with lots of non-ascii chars (music glyphs + emoji). example payload (redacted):
```
User prompt: "Compose a melody using 𝄞 𝄢 and embed a link: https://..."
```
Sasha R: pasted profiler slice from g-12 (3 sample windows). observed high disk_io_wait and many KV cache evictions around the p95 window. small excerpt: 
```
2026-03-18T15:01:11Z kernel_selector: chosen_kernel=matmul_v2_large_mem reason=estimated_seq_len_bucket=8
2026-03-18T15:01:11Z kv_cache: evictions=42 tenant=acme-internal-prod node=g-12
2026-03-18T15:01:12Z host_io: swap_in_pages=1.2k wait_ms=430
```
Ashwin V: interesting — kernel_selector chose the large-mem kernel because the estimated seq len bucket was high. suspecting tokenizer mis-estimate when input contains multi-byte glyphs, which pushes selector into a different memory allocation path.
Priya S: can you repro locally with the exact prompt? if so we can route tenant to quantized / mem-light model while we patch.
Maya K: repro curl that triggered it: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-13b","input":"Compose a melody using 𝄞𝄢..."}'
```
Jon P: running that now against a debug node with tracing on. attaching trace id: trace-1765432134.
perf-bot: auto-detected regression: p95 latency for tenant=acme-internal-prod increased 560% vs baseline; flagged node=g-12.
Ashwin V: attached short flamegraph (s3://perf/traces/1765432134-flame.svg) — hot path is memory allocation + host memcpy. Kernel logs show a quick path: token_count_estimate=2300 -> choose large_mem kernel which allocates >12GB workspace, triggers host fallback for one shard.
Sasha R: KV cache churn is second-order — evictions are because workspace triggered higher memory pressure and the runtime dropped KV pages. that causes extra re-compute and IO.
Priya S: mitigation applied: created a routing override to route acme-internal-prod to rwd-llama-13b-quantized for 10m. deploy-bot: created routing rule rule-1765432201 -> active. :white_check_mark:
Maya K: after routing override p95 dropped back to ~210ms on the affected shard. confirmed no user-visible errors.
Ashwin V: root cause theory: kernel selector uses a light heuristic that maps UTF-8 byte length to token buckets for performance. when prompts contain many multi-byte glyphs, the byte-length -> token estimate overshoots. selector then picks a kernel optimized for very long sequences (different matmul kernel + larger scratch allocation) which pushes memory over a threshold on some instance types, causing host IO.
Jon P: repro with a small harness showing tokenization diff: 
```
>>> tokenizer.byte_length("𝄞")
>>> tokenizer.simulated_tokens("𝄞")
>>> heuristic_estimate = byte_length * 1.2  # selector uses this
>>> heuristic_estimate -> large bucket
```
Sasha R: action items: 1) short-term routing (done), 2) add a quick guard in kernel_selector to run a cheap tokenization dry-run for any input with non-ascii or high byte density, 3) monitor KV eviction rate.
Ashwin V: I'll open PR to change selector to prefer mem-light kernel when the dry-run indicates >25% discrepancy between byte-est and tokenizer tokens. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5382 (draft).
Priya S: also adding a fast metric: token_estimate_discrepancy per-tenant so we can auto-rollout routing if thresholds exceeded.
perf-bot: p95 returned to baseline for acme-internal-prod at 15:21:12Z.
Maya K: leaving the routing override for 1h and will watch. thanks all. :heart:
Jon P: follow-up note: if anyone sees similar spikes check for non-ascii-heavy prompts + kernel_selector logs on node. quick grep: 
```
grep -R "chosen_kernel" /var/log/runtime | grep large_mem | grep tenant=
```
Ashwin V: will land PR with tests that include multi-byte glyph cases. tagging @sasha for the KV eviction alert rule change.
Sasha R: ack, I'll add alert: "kv_eviction_rate > 30/min AND token_estimate_discrepancy > 0.25 => paging_imminent".
Maya K: updating incident doc now. saving traces under incidents/1765432109-unicode-iops.
deploy-bot: routing rule rule-1765432201 will auto-expire at 15:31:12Z.
perf-bot: closing alert (timeout) after p95 stable 10m.
